DELIVERABLES & ARMS:
- tools/regression-store-loss.sh implementing all 5 arms:
  1. A16 (S10-STORE-1): Atomic census update on every store write (row_count + 64-char sha256 digest + sorted ids + written_by verb), co-committed in the same wave. Null control: intact store is silent across read-only surfaces (orient, status, resume, audit) and orient exits 0.
  2. A17 (S10-STORE-2): Mutating write on a reverted store (live store smaller than census) is REFUSED (exit non-zero) with diagnostic stderr naming live rows, census rows, missing IDs, and census path; store remains unmutated. Null: legitimate purge/retire proceeds.
  3. A18 (S10-STORE-3): Read-time check on reverted store (orient) emits loud stderr ALARM naming the gap, missing IDs, and census path, and exits 1.
  4. A19 (S10-STORE-4): Legitimate shrinks through retire/purge/archive record removed IDs in census, do not alarm, and subsequent reads are clean; unrecorded shrinks trigger alarm and write refusal.
  5. SMOKE-4 (S10-SMOKE-4): End-to-end incident reproduction: 3-task store reverted to 1 task -> mutation refused -> orient alarms loudly and exits 1 -> --reconcile-store-loss reasoned escape succeeds and updates census -> subsequent orient clean (exit 0).
